about_the_game:
Welcome to the Prism, a unique emotional sandbox simulation where the player's goal is balance. Identify, engage, and express eccentric alien creatures that represent human emotions.

What’s hiding in the dark fog? Using sounds, movement patterns, and thoughts as hints, learn how to identify your emotions before you can start engaging with them. It gets easier as you go!

It’s important to engage with your emotions in a healthy way instead of bottling them up. Give your Emoes attention to maintain them, and build structures to help manage your Emoes more effectively. Your Emoes also have unique properties. Emoes of the same type can merge to create higher intensity emotions, and Emoes holding too much charge will split into more Emoes. Learn how to manage your population of Emoes and keep your Prism in a steady equilibrium.

Expressing your emotions can be relieving and cathartic. Express your Emoes to release charge from the system and help keep your Prism in balance.

Obtain unique collectibles through experimentation and play to shed light on the mysterious origins of the Prism.
